claim: Someone evaluating DemoKit for their own product will believe it can navigate a real observability app - virtualised search, dark theme, panels that only draw once their queries come back - and prove the dashboard it opened is the one it went looking for.
_ledger: S0  Grafana's public playground, the dashboard browser  <- where the viewer starts
S1  the list filtered down to one match, with its folder and tags <- type "Business Metrics"
S2  the dashboard itself: sign-ups, logins, payments, reviews <- click the result

steps.label: search the dashboards
steps.shows: the list narrowed to one match, with the folder it lives in

steps.label: open the dashboard
steps.shows: sign-ups, logins, signouts, support calls - every panel drawn from a live query
